description: This file implements a React component for a notes management web application, including data fetching, CRUD operations, and UI rendering for notes and their editing interface.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches notes and a specific note based on URL parameters, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles create, update, and delete actions for notes based on form submissions.

methods.name: NotesApp
methods.description: Main React component rendering the entire notes application UI including sidebar and detail pane.
